title: THIS IS INSANE GEMMA4 Google just released the most capable opensource model  called Gemma 4 #ai
description:
Google just released the most capable opensource model in the world Its called Gemma 4 and it wasnt too long ago that running a model as powerful as this required seriously expensive hardware with tradeoffs Now it can run on just about any laptop or computer you might have at home This is a big leap for the opensource community One of the most important things to understand here is the Apache 20 license it was released under Its a commercially permissive license which means you are allowed to do almost anything you want with the code You can use it to build a giant company and make billions of dollars You can take the code and modify it even redistribute it to all of your friends and sublicense a new version of it google gemma4 ai
Roberto Nickson
